description.text: The Dialga deck of the DPt Entry Pack, released on 10 October 2008 with the first expansion of the Platinum series, Galactic's Conquest. For newcomers it held three ready-built 30-card half decks led by Dialga, Palkia and Giratina, the Pokémon on the boxes of Pokémon Diamond, Pearl and Platinum, with a coin, damage counters and markers, a how-to-play sheet and a practice playmat. It had no Pokémon LV.X and no SP Pokémon. This deck pairs Dialga with Infernape.
